## Finding (recorded defect — never claimed, never fixed in-place)

`hharness_eval::finite_manifest::finite_manifest_contrast` validates
`decl.prior ∈ {beta{1,1}, beta{2,2}}` but the posterior mean + seeded
draws use hardcoded `(c+1, n−c+1)` — a `beta{2,2}` run persists
`prior.beta.{2,2}`/`predeclared_exploratory` over Beta(1,1) math: a
mislabeled sensitivity arm (independent review's catch — exactly the
behavior an independent numerical check exists to surface). Recorded
as DF-R5.17-1 OPEN → R5.40/GATE-G10 (proposed seam ~6 lines:
parameterize the conjugate update by `decl.prior`; registered arm
byte-identical). The verification ticket never repairs a shared
contract in-place (consume-predecessors-unchanged; semantic changes
return to the owning admission).
